item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:30 AM 22 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Magallanes, Juban, Casiguran, Gubat, Barcelona, Matnog, SantaMagdalena), #NorthernSamar(Capul, SanAntonio, Lavezares, Allen, Rosario, Victoria, SanIsidro), #CamarinesSur(Tinambac) and #CamarinesNorte(Basud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Bacacay, RapuRapu, SantoDomingo, LegazpiCity, Manito, Daraga, Camalig, Jovellar, PioDuran), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Castilla, Donsol, Pilar), #Catanduanes(Pandan, Caramoran), #CamarinesSur(Siruma), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Daet, Talisay, Vinzons and Paracale) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
